thread:
ravi: Cutting RC v3.0.0-rc.0 for gateway-service. Artifact gh:ri/gateway@sha:beef001. Planning promo in change window 09:30-10:30 PT, request start 09:40.

deploy-bot: rc created by ravi. Canary set: gateway-canary-2. CI: all green. smoke: ok.

jo: quick note: there's a small config change to client-timeout default. It's behind a flag `client_timeout_opt_in`. We should keep it off during promo.

aman: agreed keep flag OFF. Also there was a flaky test in auth integration last night but fixed in this sha. QA please keep an eye.

qa-bot: nightly integration run flaky_tests: 0 for this artifact. Regression checks passed.

ravi: rollback plan (short): promote previous pinned artifact and change routing back. Script: `deploybot promote --artifact gh:ri/gateway@sha:prev888 --env prod --tag rollback`

jo: recommend soft rollout: 2% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with holds [10m, 15m, 15m]. Abort early if 5xx spike or p95 > 2x.

sheriff: I'll watch 09:35-10:45. Abort criteria acknowledged.

ravi: release notes snippet:
- gateway: improve header parsing performance
- change: new client timeout flag (OFF)
- fix: auth token refresh edge-case

deploy-bot: promo preview:
`deploybot promote --artifact gh:ri/gateway@sha:beef001 --env prod --traffic 2 --notes "soft-rollout, flag OFF"`

aman: scheduling: I'll start the promo at 09:40 PT. @jo monitor auth latencies, @qa-bot run smoke after 2% lift.

jo: watching auth and frontend gateway errors.

qa-bot: post-2% smoke: no failures, p95 +3%.

aman: proceed to 20%.

deploy-bot: ramping to 20%.

jo: at 20% hold: small increase in timeouts to one downstream endpoint, investigating.

aman: rolling back downstream retries config for that endpoint, will hold 20% until stable.

sheriff: hold acknowledged. no abort yet.

jo: after adjusting retries, metrics back to baseline. ready for 60%.

aman: ramping to 60% now.

deploy-bot: ramp complete, holding 15m.

qa-bot: 60% hold: no new 5xxs, p95 stable.

ravi: proceed to 100%.

deploy-bot: ramping to 100%  promotion complete. artifact gh:ri/gateway@sha:beef001 live in prod.

jo: updating release notes channel and tagging artifact.

sheriff: ending watch. If any regressions open incident and page. :thumbsup:
